_comment: The Windows client's OWN strings: the ones the apps' Localizable.xcstrings does not hold.
A key with an empty object is ENGLISH FOR NOW in every language — recorded here rather than
quietly drawn in English by nine catalogues that look complete. The web client keeps exactly
the same file for exactly the same reason (web/i18n/web.json), and these five are the same

en.one: %lld member now. Nobody new can join until somebody leaves; no one is removed.
en.other: %lld members now. Nobody new can join until somebody leaves; no one is removed.
